entities.name: Gared
entities.description: Hunchback assistant of Liliana Vess on Innistrad, formerly Dierk's assistant.

entities.name: Dierk
entities.description: Geistmage and Gared's former master, killed by Eldrazi werewolves.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: Artifact Dierk and Gared experimented with; the experiment failed.

entities.name: Lurenbaum Fortress
entities.description: Fortress where Olivia's vampires cast long shadows.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: Place where Liliana amassed a horde of zombies.

entities.name: Battle of Thraben
entities.description: Battle Gared did not take part in directly.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: Dealt with by Liliana at Thraben.

events.summary: Gared stands by Dierk as they study the Chain Veil; the experiment fails and Liliana packs to leave.
events.quote: Gared remained steadfast, offering his support as Liliana packed her belongings to depart.

events.summary: Dierk is killed by Eldrazi werewolves.
events.quote: In the wake of Dierk's demise at the hands of Eldrazi werewolves

events.summary: Gared and Liliana go to Lurenbaum Fortress and the vampires of Olivia Voldaren.
events.quote: Together, they ventured to Lurenbaum Fortress

events.summary: After Liliana's parley with Olivia, Gared retrieves his blood-stained coat from Dierk's body.
events.quote: Gared solemnly retrieved his blood-stained coat from the lifeless form of his former mentor

events.summary: Gared accompanies Liliana to Thraben but waits outside during the battle.
events.quote: Gared did not participate in the Battle of Thraben directly, waiting outside
